Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling in the northbound lane on a city street in Pasadena, Texas, when a vehicle operated by Driver
2 crossed into the same lane and the two front ends made contact at low speed. Driver 1 reported pain in the right
wrist after the impact and was transported for evaluation. The wrist complaint is consistent with the force and direction
of the collision as obesrved at the scene. Both vehicles sustained front-end damage that corresopnds closely to the
impact described by each driver, and scene photographs document this damage. No prior damage to the vehicle
operated by Driver 1 was identified during the inspection. Responding officers and the on-scene statements confirm
that a passenger was seated in the vehicle at the time of the collision. No independent witnesses came forward, so
the account relies on the drivers' statements and the physical evidence. Driver 1 is listed as a named insured on the
policy covering the vehicle.
